signature_verification: apksigner verify passed, v2 and v3

cloud_signing_blocker: GitHub integration rejects Actions secret access with HTTP 403

graphics_scope: 2.5D top-down combat with textured and lit 3D asteroid meshes; not a full free-flight 3D conversion.
impact_validation: Mass-scaled projectile impulse, off-centre torque, ram momentum conservation and dissipation, enlarged hull contact, real game ramming with and without invulnerability, one destruction, no live child asteroids, and bounded cosmetic shard lifetime.
controls_update: Centre default, old preference migration, and intentional two-thumb handover inside the fixed pad.
rock_rendering: 12 irregular boulder meshes with baked blended materials and independent angular shard meshes. Native gallery and actual GameSurface phone-dimension renders inspected.
asteroid_contact_validation: Head-on, unequal-mass, glancing/spin, momentum and energy, negative-coordinate grid, coincident and separating contacts, chain impacts, 800-rock sparse field, fast small rocks, 30/60/120 Hz consistency, a five-second crowded simulation, and real game/pause/post-death integration passed.
asteroid_contact_scope: Circular top-down bounds, restitution and Coulomb friction with disc inertias; 120 Hz ordinary substeps and speed-adaptive smaller steps, bounded to 32 per frame. Rock-to-rock contact changes motion without damage or splitting.
owner_menu_validation: Issuer and installation binding, invalid signature/input, fail-closed flags, non-depleting wallet, normal balance restoration, overflow protection, unauthorized dialog rejection and command handling tested. Real Android Keystore and Samsung screen-lock flow not physically tested.
owner_activation_status: Awaiting the actual owner installation code; no grant has been pre-issued.
